title: Content Outlines And Scripts For 10/17 SixPackAbs.com Shoot
text:
SCRIPT: Bill Maher Asks If You've Ever Seen A Fat 90-Year-Old. He's Right.


Filming script. 146 spoken words plus the 18 second clip, about 62 seconds at Dan's pace (198 words a minute). Lines in brackets and ALL CAPS are notes for filming and for the editor, not read aloud. The clip plays first, with Dan on screen watching in silence. No hook takes.


[OPEN ON THE CLIP, PLAYING BEHIND DAN ON THE GREEN SCREEN. DAN IS ON SCREEN WATCHING IT AND DOES NOT SPEAK UNTIL IT ENDS: REAL TIME WITH BILL MAHER, NEW RULE: FAT ACCEPTANCE, 2:15 TO 2:33. LOWER THIRD: BILL MAHER, REAL TIME (HBO)]


Bill Maher is right. There is no such thing as being “healthy at any size.”


If you’re overfat right now, it’s comforting to tell yourself that you can be healthy at any size. But that is a lie, and that lie is literally killing you.


[ON SCREEN TEXT: TREAT YOUR BELLY FAT AS AN EMERGENCY]


That’s why you need to treat your belly fat as an emergency. Because the future is going to be amazing, and if you don’t lose the weight you aren’t going to be around to see how awesome it will be.


[FULL SCREEN GRAPHIC: A BMI TABLE, HEIGHT DOWN THE SIDE AND WEIGHT ACROSS THE TOP, WITH THE NORMAL, OVERWEIGHT AND OBESE BANDS IN DIFFERENT COLORS. HOLD IT FOR THE NEXT THREE LINES]


Here’s a BMI table to tell if you’re overweight.


If you’re in the “overweight” category, your health will tremendously improve if you get to a healthy weight.


And if you’re in the “obese” category, losing fat is literally the most important thing you can do.


[BACK ON DAN]


[ON SCREEN: SUBSCRIBE]


Subscribe to my channel to learn exactly how to lose your belly fat and get abs.
